question: Should this PR remain a broad cross-surface cleanup bundle after the UI coalescing bug is fixed, or should it be narrowed to grouped tool activity and directly related tests?
rationale: The functional UI fix is reviewable, but the same branch also changes automation, workflows, mobile deep-link defaults, plugin/runtime code, and many test harnesses; that scope choice is maintainer intent, not a mechanical code-review fact.

options.title: Fix UI Bug And Narrow Scope
options.body: Repair the coalescing defect and split unrelated automation/default/plugin changes into separately reviewable PRs or owner-approved follow-ups.

options.title: Accept Broad Bundle
options.body: Keep the broad branch intact, but require explicit maintainer ownership and upgrade proof for the deep-link default and automation/script changes before merge.

options.title: Pause Until Scope Owner Decides
options.body: Hold the PR after the UI finding until the relevant UI and automation owners agree on what belongs in this branch.

recommendation.title: Fix UI Bug And Narrow Scope
recommendation.body: Repair the coalescing defect and split unrelated automation/default/plugin changes into separately reviewable PRs or owner-approved follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` opened this branch and authored recent merged tool-row work that the UI portion builds on, so they are the best routing candidate for the scope decision.
